zh: 卡赞在开场任务取得刀斧。
en: Khazan receives paired blades in the opening mission, making Chapter 1 the starting point for this class.

zh: 巨剑是官方列出的三类武器之一。
en: Greatsword is one of the three weapon classes listed by the publisher.

zh: 长枪是官方列出的三类武器之一。
en: Spear is one of the three weapon classes listed by the publisher.

zh: Crimson Fiend：围绕蓄力与 Mortal Blow 选择；通过掉落及对应卷轴制作补齐。
en: Crimson Fiend supports a charged-attack and Mortal Blow direction; check drops and its crafting scroll.

zh: 英雄武器与防具套装属于豪华版专属内容；官方说明不能通过之后的其他方式取得。
官方列出的套装加成按穿戴 2 至 6 件逐级触发，分别增加 Vitality、Endurance、Proficiency、Strength 和 Willpower 各 5 点。
en: The Hero's weapon and armor set is a Deluxe Edition exclusive, not a standard mission drop.
The official 2–6 piece bonuses add 5 each to Vitality, Endurance, Proficiency, Strength and Willpower in sequence.

zh: 先练习普通连段结束后及时停手，再考虑增加段数的 Blazing Assault；后续按需要查看 Whirlwind 与追击方向。
en: Practise stopping a basic string safely before extending it with Blazing Assault. Inspect Whirlwind and pursuit options as your available points grow.

zh: 官方说明支持随时随地重置和重新分配技能。
en: The official store description says skill points can be reset and reassigned at any time and from anywhere.

zh: 死亡后可返回倒下地点取回失去的 Lacrima，以继续升级。
en: After death, returning to the defeat location can recover lost Lacrima for progression.

zh: 官方故事页列出的量表来源包括击败敌人、Brutal Attack 与 Spirit 技能。
量表满后可在限定时间内变身；变身期间受到的伤害会扣除幻影形态量表而非生命值。
en: The official story page names enemy defeats, Brutal Attacks and Spirit skills as gauge sources.
At a full gauge, Khazan can transform for a limited time; damage taken then drains the Phantom Form gauge rather than health.

zh: 角色养成、技能和已持有装备可以带入下一周目；任务流程需要重新推进。
en: Character progression, skills and held equipment carry into the next journey, while mission progression restarts.

zh: 推进 Blacksmith’s Heirloom 相关任务以开放铁匠功能；制作时同时检查配方、材料和成品预览。
en: Progress through Blacksmith’s Heirloom to access the blacksmith. Check the recipe, materials and resulting item before crafting.

zh: 前期：以短连段和及时回避为主，把技能点投入实际能命中的动作，保留回避所需精力。
en: Early: use short strings and leave stamina for evasive movement. Invest in moves you can reliably connect.

zh: 按顺序解锁五组：Tides of Ruin、Earthshaking Roar、Unyielding Foes、Corruptors、Nightmare of Chaos。提供固定的等级、装备与资源，重点是用同一套条件稳定完成整组。
en: Unlock five groups in sequence: Tides of Ruin, Earthshaking Roar, Unyielding Foes, Corruptors and Nightmare of Chaos. Levels, gear and resources are provided.

zh: 包含防御动作速查表、爆发攻击与抓取处理、削韧和致命攻击，以及常见失败原因。
en: Includes defensive action tables, Burst Attacks and grabs, exhaustion and Brutal Attacks, and troubleshooting.

zh: 在第二章解锁技能树后，先选当前使用的武器。灰色节点先看熟练度和前置连线，再看点数；已学但无法发动时，检查激活条件与技能管理中的启用状态。
en: After the Chapter 2 skill-tree introduction, choose your current weapon. For a locked node, check Mastery and prerequisites before points. For an unusable learned skill, check activation conditions and Skill Management.

zh: 选择要制作的具体部位，检查专属材料、通用材料和金币；部位、等级或品质变化时，重新核对预览。
en: Select the individual slot and inspect special materials, generic materials and Gold. Recheck when slot, level or grade changes.

zh: 完成“斯顿雪域的斗鬼”后，实际打开魔剑的能力菜单并选择同行。解锁记录出现不等于已经装备。
en: After Stormpass’ Phantom of Combat, open the abilities menu at a Blade Nexus and select a companion. Unlocking one does not automatically equip it.

zh: 购买或制作后检查快捷栏与背包库存。魔剑处的快捷补充不等于无限生成消耗品；来源、库存和次数型恢复道具要分开看。
en: After buying or crafting, check shortcuts and inventory. Shortcut refilling at a Nexus does not generate unlimited consumables; distinguish stored items from charged healing supplies.
